panels.description: Validator uptime over time. Series: uptime = time since validator boot (nanoseconds; auto-scaled).
panels.title: Validator Uptime

panels.description: Tile state over time. Series: each line is a tile (kind/kind_id); value is status (0=booting, 1=running, 2=shutdown).
panels.title: Tile Status

panels.description: Tile busy share over time. Series: each line is a tile (kind/kind_id); value is share of time the tile spends outside caught_up regimes.
panels.title: Tile Busy %

panels.description: Approximate time since each tile last heartbeated. Computed from tile heartbeat tick deltas (same-instance baseline), then normalized to seconds using observed heartbeat tick rate.
panels.title: Tile Heartbeat Age

panels.description: Backpressure events by tile. Series: each line is a tile (kind/kind_id); value is times the tile had to wait for consumers to catch up before publishing.
panels.title: Tile Backpressure Count

panels.description: Tile backpressure state over time. Series: each line is a tile (kind/kind_id); value is 1 when backpressured, 0 otherwise.
panels.title: Tile Backpressure

panels.description: Rates of tile_context_switch_involuntary_count and tile_context_switch_voluntary_count per tile.
panels.title: Tile Context Switch Rates

panels.description: Link health signals for producer/consumer pressure. Series: overrun_polling = times the link was overrun while polling; overrun_reading = times the link was overrun while reading; slow = times the producer detected the consumer was throttling.
panels.title: Link Overruns / Slow

panels.description: Link fragment flow and drop signals. Series: consumed = fragments consumed by the link reader; filtered = fragments filtered and not consumed; overrun_poll_frag = fragments not processed because the link was overrun while polling; overrun_read_frag = fragments not processed because the link was overrun while reading.
panels.title: Link Fragments

panels.description: Sock tile packet traffic. Series: rx = packets received by the sock tile; tx = packets sent by the sock tile.
panels.title: Sock Packets (PPS)

panels.description: Sock tile byte traffic. Series: rx = bytes received; tx = bytes transmitted.
panels.title: Sock Bytes (B/s)

panels.description: Sock tile packet drop activity. Series: tx_drop = packets that failed to send.
panels.title: Sock Drops

panels.description: Sock tile syscall rates. Series: recvmmsg = receive syscalls; sendmmsg = send syscalls by result.
panels.title: Sock Syscalls

panels.description: Inbound TPU transactions by receive type. Series: each line is a tpu_recv_type; value is TPU transactions received via that path (udp, quic_fast, quic_frag).
panels.title: QUIC Transactions Received

panels.description: QUIC wire traffic. Series: rx = bytes received (includes IP/UDP/QUIC headers); tx = bytes sent (includes headers).
panels.title: QUIC Bytes (B/s)

panels.description: QUIC connection counts by state. Series: each line is a quic_conn_state; value is current connections in that state.
panels.title: QUIC Connections by State

panels.description: QUIC packet errors by cause. Series: crypto_failed = packets dropped due to decrypt failure; no_key = packets dropped due to missing key; no_conn = packets dropped for unknown connection; oversz = packets dropped for being too large; undersz = packets dropped for being too small; quic_header_invalid = packets dropped for invalid QUIC header; net_header_invalid = packets dropped for invalid IP/UDP header.
panels.title: QUIC Packet Errors

panels.description: QUIC processing latency percentiles. Series: receive_p50/p95/p99 = packet processing duration; service_p50/p95/p99 = service loop duration.
panels.title: QUIC Durations (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: QUIC connection lifecycle events. Series: created/closed/aborted/timed_out/retried = connection lifecycle events; no_slots = connection creation failures due to no slots; retry_fail = retry failures.
panels.title: QUIC Connection Lifecycle

panels.description: QUIC transaction fragment and reassembly activity. Series: reasms_started = fragmented transaction reassembly starts; frags_ok = transaction fragments received; frags_gap = fragments dropped due to gaps; frags_dup = fragments dropped as duplicates; txns_overrun = transactions dropped due to reassembly overrun; txns_abandoned = transactions abandoned because a connection was lost.
panels.title: QUIC Reassembly / Fragments

panels.description: QUIC handshake pressure. Series: created = handshakes created; alloc_fail = handshakes dropped due to allocation failure; evicted = handshakes evicted.
panels.title: QUIC Handshake Alloc/Evict

panels.description: QUIC packet traffic and reliability events. Series: rx_packets = packets received; tx_packets = packets sent; retransmits = packets retransmitted; retry_sent = retry packets sent; verneg = version negotiation packets received.
panels.title: QUIC Packets / Retransmits

panels.description: Current quic_connections_alloc and quic_txn_reasms_active, plus quic_frame_fail_parse rate.
panels.title: QUIC Connections / Reassembly

panels.description: Rates of quic_ack_tx outcomes, top quic_received_frames types, and quic_frame_tx_alloc outcomes.
panels.title: QUIC ACK / Frame Rates

panels.description: Verify-stage transaction errors and gossip votes. Series: parse_failure = transactions that failed to parse; dedup_failure = transactions that failed dedup in verify stage; verify_failure = transactions that failed signature verification; bundle_peer_failure = transactions dropped due to bundle peer failure; gossip_votes = simple vote transactions received via gossip.
panels.title: Verify Failures

panels.description: Dedup-stage transaction errors and gossip votes. Series: dedup_failure = transactions that failed dedup in dedup stage; bundle_peer_failure = transactions dropped due to bundle peer failure; gossip_votes = simple vote transactions received via gossip.
panels.title: Dedup Failures

panels.description: Resolh-stage drop/error counters. Series: blockhash_expired = transactions dropped due to expired blockhash; no_bank_drop = transactions dropped due to missing bank; bundle_peer_failure = transactions dropped due to bundle peer failure.
panels.title: Resolh Errors

panels.description: Resolh stash activity. Series: inserted = transactions stashed for unknown blockhash; published = stashed transactions published when the blockhash resolhed; removed = stashed transactions removed without publish; overrun = transactions dropped because the stash was full.
panels.title: Resolh Stash Ops

panels.description: Pack transaction pool size by type. Series: all = total pending transactions available to schedule; regular = non-vote transactions in main treap; votes = simple vote transactions; conflicting = transactions writing hot accounts; bundles = transactions that are part of a bundle.
panels.title: Pack Available Transactions

panels.description: Pack pool capacity utilization. Series: utilization = percent of pack pending transaction capacity currently filled by available transactions.
panels.title: Pack Pool Utilization %

panels.description: Pack scheduling decision outcomes. Series: taken = transaction scheduled; cu_limit = skipped due to block CU limit; fast_path = skipped due to account conflict (fast check); byte_limit = skipped due to block data limit; write_cost = skipped due to per-account write cost limit; slow_path = skipped due to account conflict (full check); defer_skip = skipped after repeated per-account write cost limit.
panels.title: Pack Schedule Outcomes

panels.description: Pack transaction drop reasons. Series: expired = transactions dropped because TTL expired; deleted = transactions dropped by delete request; dropped_extra = transactions dropped from extra storage; partial_bundle = transactions dropped because part of a partial bundle; already_executed = transactions dropped because already executed.
panels.title: Pack Drop Reasons

panels.description: Pack scheduling/complete/insert latency percentiles. Series: schedule_p50/p95/p99 = time to schedule a microblock; complete_p50/p95/p99 = time to complete a microblock; insert_p50/p95/p99 = time to insert a transaction into pack.
panels.title: Pack Latency (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: Compute unit usage percentiles per pack. Series: p50/p95/p99 = percent of block CU limit used per pack.
panels.title: Pack CU Usage

panels.description: Pack input vs accepted transactions. Series: received = normal TPU transactions received; inserted = transactions accepted into pack.
panels.title: Pack Input vs Inserted

panels.description: Pack insertion outcomes. Series: each line is a pack_txn_insert_return outcome; value is insert attempts that returned that outcome.
panels.title: Pack Insert Outcomes (Top 6)

panels.description: Pack time distribution by state. Series: each line is a pack_timing_state; value is percent of time pack spent in that state.
panels.title: Pack Timing State %

panels.description: Pack block-level limit hits. Series: microblock_limit = times pack could not pack due to microblock-per-block limit; data_limit = times pack could not pack due to data-per-block limit.
panels.title: Pack Limit Hits

panels.description: Mean scheduler/insert/complete pack durations from *_sum/*_count rate ratios.
panels.title: Pack Scheduler Mean Durations

panels.description: Rates of pack_bundle_crank_status outcomes with pack_cus_consumed_in_block and pack_smallest_pending_transaction.
panels.title: Pack Bundle Crank / CU State

panels.description: Address lookup table resolve outcomes. Series: success = LUT resolved; invalid_lookup_index = LUT lookup index missing; account_uninitialized = LUT account not initialized; invalid_account_data = LUT account data invalid; invalid_account_owner = LUT account owned by wrong program; account_not_found = LUT account missing.
panels.title: Resolh LUT Results

panels.description: Bank pre-execution failures. Series: sanitize_failure = transactions that failed sanitize; not_executed = transactions that did not execute.
panels.title: Bank Sanitize / Not Executed

panels.description: Bank transaction outcomes. Series: success = transactions executed and succeeded; executed_failed = transactions executed and failed; fee_only = transactions that paid fee but did not execute; processing_failed = transactions dropped before chain.
panels.title: Bank Transaction Outcomes

panels.description: Bank transaction errors. Series: each line is a transaction_error value; value is failed transactions with that error.
panels.title: Bank Errors (Top 5)

panels.description: Cost model undercount events. Series: undercount = transactions that exceeded the cost model allowance.
panels.title: Bank Cost Model Undercount

panels.description: Bank ALUT load outcomes. Series: success = ALUT loaded; slot_hashes_sysvar_not_found = slot hashes sysvar missing; account_not_found = ALUT account missing or deactivated; invalid_account_owner = ALUT account owned by wrong program; invalid_account_data = ALUT account data invalid; invalid_index = ALUT lookup index missing.
panels.title: Bank ALUT Load Results

panels.description: Leader pipeline delay percentiles. Series: begin_leader_p50/p95/p99 = delay from leader start to bank receipt; first_microblock_p50/p95/p99 = delay to first microblock; slot_done_p50/p95/p99 = delay to slot completion; bundle_init_p50/p95/p99 = delay to bundle crank init.
panels.title: PoH Delays (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: Mean PoH delays by stage from *_sum/*_count rate ratios.
panels.title: PoH Mean Delay by Stage

panels.description: Incoming shred processing results. Series: bad_slot = shreds for slots with unknown leader; parse_failed = shreds that failed to parse; rejected = invalid shreds; ignored = duplicate or already reconstructed shreds; okay = shreds accepted into incomplete FEC sets; completes = shreds that completed FEC sets.
panels.title: Shred Processing Results

panels.description: Shred reject/spill counters. Series: rejected_initial = rejected before allocation; rejected_unchained = non-chained merkle shreds; fec_rejected_fatal = fatal FEC rejection; fec_spilled = FEC sets spilled; microblocks_abandoned = microblocks abandoned on slot switch; bad_nonce = repair responses with an incorrect nonce.
panels.title: Shred Rejects & Spills

panels.description: Shred duration percentiles. Series: shredding_p50/p95/p99 = producing one FEC set; add_shred_p50/p95/p99 = verifying and processing one received shred.
panels.title: Shred Durations (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: Leader transactions inserted into store. Series: inserted = leader transactions inserted into store.
panels.title: Store Transactions Inserted

panels.description: Signature latency percentiles. Series: sign_p50/p95/p99 = time to sign a message.
panels.title: Sign Duration (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: Sign ops rate (sign_sign_duration_seconds_count) and mean sign duration (sum/count).
panels.title: Sign Throughput / Mean Duration

panels.description: Shred input and error rates. Series: turbine_rcv = turbine shreds received; repair_rcv = repair shreds received; bad_nonce = repair responses with an incorrect nonce; invalid_block_id = blocks created with unknown parent block id.
panels.title: Shred Input / Error Rates

panels.description: Mean shred durations from *_sum/*_count rate ratios.
panels.title: Shred Mean Durations
